He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: So Aaron came near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
translations.bsb: So Aaron approached the altar and slaughtered the calf as a sin offering for himself.
translations.kjv: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering,
translations.asv: So Aaron drew near unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin-offering, which was for himself.
